faqs.question: How does the fast dry time work in Phoenix's heat?
faqs.answer: Phoenix's warm, dry climate is actually perfect for our Hot Carbonating Extraction process! Because we use about 80% less water than traditional steam cleaning, your carpets dry in just 1-2 hours - even faster in Phoenix's dry heat. This means you can get back to your normal routine the same day, without the humidity and dampness of traditional steam cleaning.

faqs.question: What makes your service different for Phoenix homes?
faqs.answer: We've been serving Phoenix for over 30 years, so we understand the unique challenges Phoenix homes face: intense UV exposure, desert dust, year-round allergens, and the wear from indoor/outdoor desert living. Our Hot Carbonating Extraction is perfect for Phoenix's climate - it deep cleans without soaking carpets, removes desert dust and allergens effectively, and dries incredibly fast in our dry climate.

faqs.question: Can you remove desert dust and allergens?
faqs.answer: Yes! This is one of our specialties. Our Hot Carbonating Extraction process removes 98% of allergens from carpets, including the desert dust, pollen, and particulates that are constant challenges in Phoenix. We also offer dedicated allergen removal treatments that are especially important for Phoenix residents dealing with year-round allergy triggers.

faqs.answer: In many cases, yes! We understand that Phoenix families have busy schedules. Depending on our technicians' availability in your Phoenix neighborhood, we can often accommodate same-day or next-day appointments. Call us at (480) 649-3663 to check availability for your area.
